evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、bin/dsh-tui.js、src/index.ts、src/dsh-adapter/index.ts、src/dsh-adapter/plugin.ts、src/dsh-adapter/channel/projection.ts、src/dsh-adapter/approvals.ts；src/index只re-export dsh-adapter入口。apply若已有entrySlot就attach，否则等待loader稳定后在Cordis子fiber加载runtime，防止互等。plugin创建startup session和channel，随后注册TuiChannel并mountChannelUi；DSH投影器先把原生事件/stream翻译成共享projector输入，对live和replay显式区分，reset同时清两层状态。相对自制终端抓日志，事件模型和生命周期边界更清楚，能复用同一投影处理恢复；并不自动保证所有复杂卡片无重复或丢失。

findings.text: 适合长期在终端/SSH里使用DSH、希望查看流式回答、工具卡与会话状态的开发者。合格结果是输入、审批、历史恢复与当前Agent状态对应，原办法为DSH原生CLI或Web。该项目既有plugin入口也有独立启动与composition root，不是修改DSH核心代码；对主要在浏览器工作的人，换成终端未必更方便。丰富显示改善可见性，但不是代码正确性或任务办结率证据。

依据固定包清单和作者安装说明核查分发；不以下载和Star证明采用。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 前端/profile依赖 | 终端与provider配置 | 时间未知 |
| 持续 | 宿主模型与显示缓存 | 更新与偏好维护 | 不以状态条当账单 |
| 失败恢复 | 重启与日志 | 原入口核对会话 | shared home仍有耦合 |
偏好终端或SSH的DSH开发者可先在测试profile试用长会话界面。相比原生CLI，它增加工具卡与状态投影，但任务质量和接管节时尚未实测。若终端渲染、审批或会话恢复不一致，就停用该前端并回到原DSH入口。 依据 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 状态可见 | 共享projector与channel | 接管节时 |
| 审批显示 | FIFO与external警示 | 真实目标终端全链 |
适配器到共享projector的翻译层值得复用，可减少多后端UI重复；依赖顺序放在runtime而非阻塞loader也是明确设计。复用时要保留session生命周期、replay语义与宿主权限事实，不只搬状态动画。
[Q02](#research-q02)将宿主适配、共享事件投影与终端显示分离，live/replay同路和生命周期接线比日志抓取更可核对；不是提升模型能力。
[Q03](#research-q03)全局与profile副本、终端协议及shared home会影响兼容和恢复；safe profile不代表与当前环境完全隔离。
[Q05](#research-q05)提出固定事件轨迹的实时/重放状态等价检验，假设未验证，以工具行和审批一致性作为否定条件。

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查dsh-TUI的具体任务增量、关键失败条件与可控采用路径。 ### Q01 · 终端UI适合谁，丰富显示能否直接提高编码质量？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、采用判断 #### 完整回答 适合长期在终端/SSH里使用DSH、希望查看流式回答、工具卡与会话状态的开发者。合格结果是输入、审批、历史恢复与当前Agent状态对应，原办法为DSH原生CLI或Web。该项目既有plugin入口也有独立启动与composition root，不是修改DSH核心代码；对主要在浏览器工作的人，换成终端未必更方便。丰富显示改善可见性，但不是代码正确性或任务办结率证据。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:20-26](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/29572774890a4a89ae1fa562dd15a1ae21bb3593/README.md#L20-L26) 终端UI和当前独立入口方向 ```text > An interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness. It ships a pixel-whale > header, live work status, streaming thinking, double-Esc time rewind, a > context progress bar, and a TPS gauge. Zero core changes: it consumes only > DSH's public exports, and is moving from a mounted plugin to an app with its > own entry and composition root, where DSH loads in process as the first-party > backend. Install to enable; uninstall leaves no patches behind. The prompt footer hides completed goals once the turn is idle; the Todo side panel retains their history. `Ctrl+Q` folds todos while working and hides/restores the idle goal/todo footer. Clicking its todo header also hides it while idle. Hiding changes only this display: a new goal/todo snapshot or session reveals it again, and `/goal clear` does not clear todos. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:44-64](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/29572774890a4a89ae1fa562dd15a1ae21bb3593/README.md#L44-L64) 终端输入、状态与集成声明
查看原文（21行） `````text - **Pixel whale pet** — three startup intros, click to wake; freezes after the first task. - **Launchpad and first-run guide** — every ordinary launch lands on a landing page with a **real input box** (big text + whale + quick actions, dropping whole blocks on short/narrow terminals; whale-girl images use a compact native-canvas footprint instead of leaving a large gap before the title; on by default — /settings `launchpad` off boots straight into chat); command completion matches chat: `Tab` fills the input, `Enter` runs the command and clears it. The first run walks a four-step wizard (API key / language+theme / model+workspace / shortcuts), re-runnable with `/setup`. - **Terminal-native UI** — streaming Markdown, tool cards, `/` and `@` completion, `#L12-14` ranges, history search, zh/en UI. - **Task completion notifications** — DSH, Claude and Codex notify after successful live work settles, with no queued follow-up or active goal. The title is “dsh-TUI · Task complete”; the body shows the latest settled reply as a single-line plain-text preview (Markdown formatting removed, up to 200 characters). OSC 777/9 apply an additional 2048-byte sequence budget, including title and protocol bytes, preserving whole graphemes. No reply shows only the title; BEL only rings. `/settings` → Conversation: `taskNotifications` = `unfocused` (default), `always`, or `off`; `notificationMethod` = `auto` (default), `osc9`, `bel`, or `windows`. Auto uses separate title/body fields on Ghostty/WezTerm (OSC 777) and Kitty (OSC 99); iTerm2/Warp and explicit `osc9` use a title prefix; other terminals ring the bell; delivery follows your terminal's notification/bell settings. On local Windows, `auto` resolves to `windows`, the system's native notifications: a task-completion toast. The first toast registers that user's AppUserModelID under HKCU, the toast appears about 3 seconds after the task ends (the PowerShell cold start that buys the no-extra-install route), and for DSH sessions an enabled, active external DSH notification plugin in the running profile makes dsh-TUI yield to it (no toast, no bell); an installed but disabled plugin does not suppress notifications; if that AppUserModelID cannot be written, the notification falls back to the bell instead of going silent. SSH sessions keep the attached terminal's notification protocol in `auto` mode; explicit `windows` still selects the host's native transport. tmux requires `set -g allow-passthrough on` for OSC notifications and `set -g focus-events on` for focus reporting. Terminals without focus reporting need `always`. Replay, cancellation and failures do not notify. Works in inline and fullscreen modes. - **Native cursor** — focused text inputs inherit your terminal's cursor shape, color, blinking, and enabled animation or trail effects in both inline and fullscreen modes. The `/model` picker shows the same cursor during movement between provider tabs, model rows, and effort levels, then hides it after **0.5 seconds at rest**; clipped regions fall back to the model row. The session manager also moves this cursor between the workspace rail, session rows, and search box; typing claims the search caret, and navigation returns it to the focused row. Configure animation and trail effects in your terminal. - **Images** — Kitty/Sixel thumbnails, centered preview with zoom and pan, paste-time fitting, text fallback. Kitty images scale to the reserved cells' physical pixels, including on HiDPI terminals. - **Mermaid diagrams** — ````mermaid ```` fences drawn as Unicode diagrams. - **LaTeX math** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` formulas as Unicode text, fractions and limits stacked in display blocks; `mathRendering: image` typesets block and one-row inline formulas as terminal images on graphics terminals. - **Timeline rail** — every turn clickable; timeline / scrollbar / hidden gutter. - **Side panel** — `Ctrl+B` splits the chat with a panel column once the terminal is wide enough; drag the divider to resize it. All eight built-in panels are enabled by default, and so are plugin panels registered later (`sidePanel.panels: '*'`; untick a row in `/settings` to switch to an explicit list). The header shows each inactive panel's symbol; hover to see its name. Narrow terminals and inline mode keep full-screen panels. In the `todo` panel a long goal wraps to the panel width with its phase on a separate row; when the content exceeds the viewport, focus the panel and scroll with `↑`/`↓` or the wheel (every todo is reachable too) (the compact goal row above the chat input stays a single truncated line with a hover tooltip). - **Live state** — activity animation, context bar, TPS, cache hit rate, effort, tokens, session cost estimate (main + subagents), Git and session metadata. Title, trajectory-strip and session-state animations update independently of the transcript and pause when idle or unfocused. Context-bar fill follows backend occupancy; colors estimate content composition. Compaction clears obsolete estimates, and missing composition displays a single used block with a measured used count in both hover details. - **One session manager** — `/resume` `/home` `/agentview` `/bg` `⌸`. - **Session workflow** — `/new` `/compact` `/export` `/btw`, model hot-switch, fork, rewind, vim, fullscreen draft editor. `/btw` uses an overlay when its sidebar cannot render. Main-task questionnaires and the fullscreen draft editor take priority while preserving the side question and draft. - **IDE selection channel** — a VS Code selection lands in the prompt. - **DSH integrations** — presets, skills, MCP, goals, todos, subagents, questionnaires. - **Account sign-in** — the standard profile offers pi-ai OAuth for ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, and Grok (plus OpenAI direct and Meta Muse when available), and Host-owned DeepSeek browser sign-in as `deepseek-account` on DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+. Use `/provider` or `/auth` without another plugin.
